long_description:
Join us for Kirtan, a heart-opening gathering of music, mantra, and community connection. Rooted in Bhakti Yoga—the yoga of love and devotion—this practice uses call-and-response chanting of simple mantras (repeated words or phrases) to help quiet the mind and connect more deeply to the present moment.

No experience is needed. You’re welcome to sing, listen, or simply be present—engaging in whatever way feels most comfortable. This is an accessible and welcoming space for all.

DATE: Saturday, November 7

TIME: 6:00 - 7:30 pm

COST: $35
